assessments.reasoning: The specification searches for matching sections in discovered files and assigns later processing to the nearer file.

challenge.method: Recompute the simple matching case with conflicting values for one pair in two parent levels. Check a nonmatching nearer section, root stopping, and unset against the exact text.
challenge.results: The nearer value is last when both inputs are discovered and both sections match. A nonmatching nearer section contributes no value. Root controls discovery and unset clears the effect of the pair.

limitations: This reconstruction covers the documented matching case. No editor or full glob implementation was executed.
